invariants: Provider participation does not confer governance authority.
Provider-neutral contracts belong in schemas rather than a provider repository.
Multi-entity collaboration belongs in sandbox rather than a provider repository.
StegVerse_AI remains distinct from provider identities and governance authority.
Existing StegVerse Task Registry, WorkerCoordinator, Interlock/InTr, LLM-adapter, TV/TVC, Publisher, SDK and Master Records authorities are not duplicated in SV-LLM.

completeness_assessment.organizational_decomposition: The currently enumerated repositories cover organization coordination, shared schemas, provider-neutral collaboration, the StegVerse ecosystem entity, and eight provider capability surfaces. No additional non-provider repository is presently justified by the documented architecture.
completeness_assessment.implementation_state: Repository existence does not establish implementation or integration completeness. Empty/uninitialized repositories require their role contracts and implementations to be established before runtime completeness can be claimed.
